text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is over with
Meisho
Doto successfully fulfilling all
her goals.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But we're soon met with bad news.
Адмайр Вега
must abstain from running
due to inflammation in
her legs. Worse,
there's no telling when she'll be
able to
return.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О laments the situation,
suggesting
that the only available option
is to wait. The
ever-timid Doto, however,
has another idea.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Something awakens in her, and she
resolves to be
stronger so that she can
accompany Opera O
through the year's
G1 races. Goal in mind, Doto
decides to
try a G2—January's Nikkei Shinshun
Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
